tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.subtitle: Bearer tokens let external agents read and update tasks on your behalf.
tokens.revealHint: For security, this secret is shown only once. Store it somewhere safe.
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.emptyHint: Create one above to connect an agent.
tokens.revokeBody: “{{name}}” will stop working immediately. Agents using it will lose access.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: Push status, claim, comment, and share events to chat or automation bridges. AI stays external.
webhooks.revealHint: Shown once. Bridges verify deliveries with the X-Docket-Signature header.
webhooks.name: Name
webhooks.emptyHint: Add an HTTPS endpoint above to receive task events.

invites.title: Invites
invites.subtitle: Create single-use registration links. Public signup stays closed.
invites.revealHint: This link is single-use and expires in 7 days. The secret is shown only once.
invites.emptyHint: Create a link above to invite someone privately.
invites.revokeBody: This unused link will stop working immediately.
invites.ownerOnlyHint: Only the workspace owner can create registration invites.

contacts.title: People
contacts.subtitle: People you've already collaborated with or invited — for sharing and discovery. There is no global directory.
contacts.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, or nickname…
contacts.emptyHint: Share a task or invite someone to build your contacts.

storage.title: Storage
storage.subtitle: Artifact blob usage across this workspace. Size counts stored file bytes only.
storage.sizeNote: Totals use stored blob size for file artifacts. Notes, links, and JSON live in the database and count as 0 bytes here.
storage.ownerOnlyHint: Only the workspace owner can view storage usage.
storage.emptyUploadersHint: Upload a file artifact on a task to see usage here.
